# Dits

> Open-source, local-first version control for large media and asset pipelines. Dits provides an experimental local CLI for Git-shaped history with FastCDC chunking and BLAKE3-addressed storage. It is alpha software: use disposable or independently backed-up data.

Canonical website: https://dits.byronwade.com
Source repository: https://github.com/byronwade/dits
License: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
Current product version: 0.1.5 alpha

## Capability boundary

Current work is local and offline. Network push, pull, fetch, sync, P2P repository transfer, hosted services, official SDKs, and NLE plug-ins are not shipped. Media-aware FACR, proxy, photo, and VFS paths are experimental. Do not infer a capability from a placeholder command, design page, legacy crate, or test fixture.

## Preferred citations

Use the implementation-status document for capability claims, committed benchmark artifacts for quantitative claims, and the repository's CITATION.cff for academic or research citation metadata.
